# discord_voice_channel (Resource)

Manages a voice channel. Permission overwrites are managed with `discord_channel_permission`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_voice_channel" "lounge" {
  server_id          = var.server_id
  name               = "Lounge"
  category_id        = discord_category_channel.community.id
  user_limit         = 10
  video_quality_mode = "full"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Channel name.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `bitrate` (Number) Bitrate in bits per second, at least `8000`. The maximum depends on the server's boost level (96000 to 384000). Defaults to Discord's default (64000).
- `category_id` (String) ID of the parent category channel. Omit to place the channel outside any category.
- `nsfw` (Boolean) Whether the channel is age-restricted. Defaults to `false`.
- `rate_limit_per_user` (Number) Slowmode for the voice channel's text chat. Between `0` and `21600` seconds. Defaults to `0`.
- `rtc_region` (String) Voice region ID. Omit for automatic selection.
- `user_limit` (Number) Maximum number of connected users; `0` means unlimited. Defaults to `0`.
- `video_quality_mode` (String) Camera video quality: `auto`, `full`. Defaults to `auto`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel ID.
- `position` (Number) Current sort position. Read-only; use `discord_channel_positions` to reorder channels.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_voice_channel.lounge <channel_id>
```
